_readme: The one place for what the owner fills in: the company's details (both sites' legal pages and footers), the store links, the web checkout and the prices. Empty strings stay visible as TODO marks (company) or fall back (stores: « soon »; checkout: the store badges and « web subscription coming soon »).

checkout._readme: url: one template for every plan and period, {plan} = solo|duo|famille, {period} = month|year, {lang} = en|fr|de|es; the page adds &currency=EUR|USD|… (the visitor's choice; or put {currency} in the template). links: optional per plan/period overrides, e.g. {"duo": {"year": "https://…"}}. Both empty = no web checkout yet.

prices._readme: Each currency its own round prices (decided 2026-10-23, not Stripe's conversion): the same table as the guichet's guichet.toml ([web.currencies] and the plans' web.<currency>), keep them equal. web = sold on the site (Stripe), store = App Store / Google Play in that currency (null: not known yet, the « in the app » and savings lines are hidden). year = 10 months for 12. tax: inclusive (VAT/GST inside the price) or exclusive (sales tax added at checkout, « + taxes » shown). countries: the visitor's region (browser language) that picks this currency first; the one without countries is the default. symbol: the selector's label. proposal: a price not decided yet (SGD, ILS).
